lead: Glass terrarium measuring 50x40x60 cm. Volume: 120.0 liters, vertical format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: This 50x40x60 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 120 liters is made from glass of the right thickness for its size. The outer sides are covered with decorative film you choose when ordering: wood, bamboo, marble, black or white.

The vertical orientation (60 cm tall) makes this terrarium suitable for arboreal animals, which live in tree canopies and on trunks in the wild. You can add branches, cork and artificial plants to recreate a vertical habitat. The ventilation openings are placed to create natural airflow from bottom to top, which maintains optimal humidity.

You can order this model with a custom film and background. If you need different dimensions or extra equipment (LED lighting, a thermostat, a lock), we build to your specification. Delivery to your address anywhere in Serbia.
